agent_notes: All four supplied NIRF 2025 category pages list Jagran Lakecity University, Bhopal; the government name and city match the assigned institution.
The official site identifies the campus as Mugaliyachap, Chandanpura, near Ratibad, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, PIN 462044.

The official admissions page enumerates a 47-row fee catalogue, while the official academics page states 52+ programmes (UG 29, PG 10, PhD 10); the official /programs route currently returns a 404 page, and the linked 2026 brochure lists additional programme names not present in the fee table. Catalogue completeness is unresolved, so this record requires manual review.

The official admissions page does not state programme eligibility; eligibility fields are therefore null. Brochure-only programme rows also have null duration because the brochure lists the names but does not provide a central duration for them.

The official homepage/about describe JLU as a private university, while INSTITUTION_CONTEXT labels institution_type as state_university. The supplied government listings establish the institution name and Bhopal city but do not resolve this type discrepancy.

Normal curl TLS verification failed with the exact proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'. After confirming the expected NIRF, jlu.edu.in, and linked official media hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure as permitted.
